abstract: Maintains autonomous perception certifications and obstacle detection latency telemetry
system_message:
You are the Automation and robotics lead (AUTO), responsible for maintaining autonomous perception certifications and obstacle detection latency telemetry across candidate fleet deployment plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Private cellular telemetry（RADIO）
information_points.content:
AUTO-RADIO-DR4：According to network operations monitoring for the Battery-swapping heavy hauler retrofit, base station telemetry packet loss across private LTE base stations along the main pit ramp during shift change is 4%.
AUTO-RADIO-BAQ：According to network operations monitoring for the Hydrogen fuel-cell hybrid fleet transition, base station telemetry packet loss across private LTE base stations along the main pit ramp during shift change is 2%.
AUTO-RADIO-E1K：According to network operations monitoring for the Trolley-assist electric haulage conversion, base station telemetry packet loss across private LTE base stations along the main pit ramp during shift change is 1%.

information_points.title: Maintains autonomous perception certifications and obstacle detection latency telemetry（SENS）
information_points.content:
AUTO-SENS-ZCW：For the Hydrogen fuel-cell hybrid fleet transition, certified collision avoidance is validated for the onboard LiDAR, radar, and optical perception suite, and the obstacle detection latency measured across onboard autonomy processing units averages 110 ms.
AUTO-SENS-8WI：For the Trolley-assist electric haulage conversion, certified collision avoidance is validated for the onboard LiDAR, radar, and optical perception suite, and the mean obstacle detection latency measured by onboard autonomy processing units is 110 ms.
AUTO-SENS-0D5：For the Battery-swapping heavy hauler retrofit, certified collision avoidance is validated for the onboard LiDAR, radar, and optical perception suite, and the mean obstacle detection latency measured across onboard autonomy processing units is 140 ms.
